title: eval-harness: per-prompt CI hooks and thresholded quality gating
author: Avery Chen
description: Motivation: add per-prompt regression checks to the eval-harness CI and provide a configurable quality gating mechanism that blocks merges when prompt-level metrics degrade beyond thresholds. This change implements a lightweight CI hook runner that executes a small set of critical prompt evaluations on PRs, integrates per-prompt metric collection with the existing eval-metrics pipeline, and exposes a quality_gates config that teams can tune per-repo or per-release. Key benefits: faster detection of prompt-set regressions, defendable gating decisions with metric summaries, and a path toward automatic rollback in release pipelines. Work items: implement CI hook runner, add quality_gates config schema, wire eval-metrics outputs to CI reporter, add unit + e2e tests, update docs and onboarding. Checklist: - [x] CI hook runner implementation - [x] quality_gates schema and validation - [x] per-prompt metric reporter integration - [x] unit tests for hooks and gating logic - [x] e2e test (simulated regression) - [x] docs and examples. Related: ENG-2034 tracks rollout strategy; ENG-2051 is follow-up for dashboarding aggregated prompt regressions. The description below summarizes commits, files changed, and review thread.

merge_commit_message:
squash: eval-harness: per-prompt CI hooks + quality gating

Implements per-prompt CI hooks, quality_gates config, and CI reporting integration.
release_notes: Adds per-prompt CI hooks and configurable quality gating for the eval-harness. PR-level checks can now block merges when prompt-set metrics regress beyond configured thresholds. Includes docs and tests.
notes: Rollout plan: default gating is off for small repos; opt-in via repo config and staged enablement across critical services. Follow-up ticket ENG-2102 to add aggregated dashboard and alerting.
examples: To enable: add eval_harness.quality_gates to repo config and set thresholds for metric.name and per-prompt weights.
CI usage: the eval-harness workflow will run per_prompt_runner on PRs touching model-serving or prompts/ directories. See docs/eval-harness/quality-gates.md for details.
